# ankra_cloud_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists the hosted zones in the organisation's Ankra Cloud account, whose access gateway policy `ankra_cloud_dns_zone_access` sets. Needs the `members.read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloud_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "zone_names" {
  value = [for zone in data.ankra_cloud_dns_zones.all.zones : zone.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Zones of the organisation's Ankra Cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the zone.
- `name` (String) Domain name of the zone.
- `parent_zone_id` (String) The zone this one is delegated from; null for a top-level zone.
